title: Interview Trainer
description:
We are looking for a confident and experienced **Interview Trainer** to prepare students for university admission interviews, visa interviews, credibility interviews, and other study\-abroad\-related assessments. The trainer will help students improve their English communication, confidence, presentation skills, and ability to answer interview questions effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct one\-to\-one and group interview training sessions for students planning to study abroad.
* Prepare students for **university interviews, visa interviews, credibility interviews, and scholarship interviews**.
* Conduct mock interviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Evaluate students' English communication, fluency, grammar, pronunciation, confidence, and body language.
* Help students develop clear and relevant answers based on their academic background, chosen course, university, finances, career goals, and SOP.
* Identify students' weaknesses and create personalized improvement plans.
* Train students in professional communication and interview etiquette.
* Conduct regular assessments to track students' progress.
* Keep students updated on common interview formats and expectations for different study destinations.
* Coordinate with counsellors and admissions teams regarding student profiles and training requirements.
* Maintain records of student performance and provide feedback to the relevant team.
* Motivate students and build their confidence before interviews.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in English, Communication, Education, or a related field preferred.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Previous experience in **IELTS/PTE/TOEFL training, interview training, student counselling, teaching, or study\-abroad consultancy** is an advantage.
* Good understanding of international university and visa interview processes.
* Ability to identify and correct grammar, pronunciation, and communication issues.
* Strong coaching and mentoring abilities.
* Ability to work with students from different academic and language backgrounds.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Confident and engaging personality.
* Patient and student\-focused approach.
* Strong observation and feedback skills.
* Good knowledge of study\-abroad destinations such as the **UK, Canada, USA, Australia, Ireland, and Europe**.
* Comfortable conducting both online and offline training sessions.

title: Educational Consultant – Study Abroad
company: ASTRUM GREAT INDIAN SCHOLARS PVT LTD.
description:
**Company:** Syenah Study Abroad  
**Location:** Amalanagar, Thrissur, Kerala  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time, Permanent

About the Role

Syenah Study Abroad is looking for an **experienced Academic Counsellor** to join our team in Thrissur.

The ideal candidate should have previous experience working with a **study\-abroad/overseas education consultancy** and understand student counselling, university selection, admissions and the application process.

This role involves working directly with students and parents, understanding their academic and career goals, recommending suitable study\-abroad options, and guiding them throughout their admission journey.

We are looking for someone who combines **strong counselling skills with effective follow\-up and lead\-conversion abilities** and is comfortable working towards defined targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Counsel students and parents regarding **study\-abroad opportunities** across destinations such as the UK, Europe, USA and other international destinations.
* Understand students' academic backgrounds, career goals, financial requirements and preferences.
* Recommend suitable **countries, universities, courses and study pathways** based on individual student profiles.
* Handle **walk\-in, phone and digital enquiries/leads** effectively.
* Build trust with students and parents and address their questions and objections professionally.
* Follow up consistently with prospective students and maintain an organised counselling pipeline.
* Guide students through university selection and the application and admission process.
* Explain admission requirements, tuition fees, scholarships, intakes and available study pathways.
* Assist students throughout the admission process and ensure timely follow\-ups.
* Coordinate with **application, documentation and visa teams** to ensure a smooth student journey.
* Maintain accurate student records and update the counselling pipeline.
* Work towards monthly counselling, conversion and admission targets.
* Build strong and lasting relationships with students and parents.

Requirements

* **1–3 years of experience in study\-abroad counselling or overseas education consulting.**
* **Previous experience working in a study\-abroad agency/consultancy is required.**
* Good knowledge of international education destinations, universities and admission processes.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent student counselling and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong follow\-up, negotiation and lead\-conversion abilities.
* Ability to work towards targets and deadlines.
* Good command of English.
* Knowledge of **Malayalam and/or Tamil** will be an advantage.
* Confident, self\-motivated and performance\-oriented approach.

What We Offer

* **₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month**, based on experience and suitability.
* **Performance\-based incentives.**
* Career growth opportunities within the study\-abroad industry.
* Opportunity to work with international education programs and universities.
* Supportive and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to build expertise across international destinations, universities and study pathways.

Career Growth

We are looking for people who want to **grow with the organisation**, not just fill a position.

High\-performing counsellors can take on greater responsibilities and progress towards **Senior Counsellor / Team Lead** roles as they develop their skills and consistently deliver results.

Who We Are Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
* Can understand a student's goals and turn them into a practical study\-abroad plan.
* Are confident handling questions, objections and follow\-ups.
* Have a genuine interest in international education.
* Are comfortable working towards targets while maintaining a student\-first approach.
* Want to build a long\-term career in the study\-abroad industry.

Employer Transparency

**We are hiring for Syenah Study Abroad.** Syenah Study Abroad is the actual employer for this position, and the selected candidate will be **directly employed by Syenah Study Abroad**. Our team is assisting Syenah Study Abroad with promoting and hiring for this vacancy.

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent

**Benefits:**

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

**Work Location:** In person

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
Job Description**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:1\. Customer Service \& Branch Operations**

* Handle walk\-in customers, understand their requirements, and provide accurate product/service information.
* Enter walk\-in and lead details into company software and update the status daily.
* Address customer queries professionally and ensure high satisfaction levels.
* Ensure the safe movement and submission of gold and cash to Head Office/regional office or other branches as required.
* Maintain proper grooming standards, wear company uniform or formals with formal shoes.

**2\. Sales \& Lead Management**

* Identify and generate business opportunities through cold calls, follow\-ups, and marketing activities.
* Create and maintain a database of prospective customers, follow\-up until conversion, and support customers throughout the closing process.
* Execute marketing initiatives and distribute leaflets/pamphlets near by radius to increase brand visibility.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to increase repeat business and referrals.

**3\. NBFC Coordination \& Business Development**

* Visit nearby NBFCs regularly to generate business leads.
* Build and maintain a healthy NBFC network and ensure consistent business inflow.

**4\. Sales Process Oversight \& Inventory Management**

* Oversee complete sales cycle from greeting to negotiation and final closing.
* Track daily sales performance and ensure targets are met.
* Maintain stock records, monitor stock ageing, and coordinate for replenishment.
* Ensure all operational equipment (POS, weighing machines, etc.) are functional.
* Prepare daily/weekly reports on sales, stock, and transactions.

**5\. Compliance \& SOP Adherence**

* Follow all safety, compliance, stock handling procedures and company SOPs without deviation.
* Conduct regular stock audits and ensure branch security protocols are followed.

**6\. Meetings, Reporting \& Inter\-Branch Support**

* Attend weekly, monthly, and quarterly review meetings without fail.
* Be flexible to support and work from other branches when required based on business needs.
* Ensure timely reporting, assigned tasks completion, and coordination with Regional Office /Head Office.
